name: Genmaicha
description: Green tea blended with roasted brown rice, some of it popped.

tcm.note: Green tea with roasted grain — cooler than hojicha, warmer than sencha.

ayurveda.note: Shita, tempered by the roasted rice.

stimulant.note: Green tea cut with roasted rice, so there is simply less leaf per cup.

effects.note: Trials pairing L-theanine with caffeine report calmer, steadier attention than caffeine alone — the doses studied run supplement-strength, above what one cup delivers. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
